findings.claim: The team documentation contradicts the generated manifest by calling `fhir-tech-lead` read-only even though the manifest grants it write ownership and Edit/Write tools.
findings.evidence: The docs say `Read-only personas (`fhir-tech-lead`, the reviewers and the validator) never modify tracked files`, while the Portable team roster gives `fhir-tech-lead` owned write paths such as `.kbd-orchestrator/phases/*/goals.md` and `.prometheus/agent-ledger.jsonl`; `.agent-team/roles/fhir-tech-lead.md` header also declares `tools: [Agent, Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, SendMessage, Edit, Write]` and `owns: [...]` for those paths.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove `fhir-tech-lead` from the read-only persona statement or qualify the statement as applying only to the pre-export installed Claude agent, then document the manifest-era write scope consistently.
